scenes.title_cn: 有效设计的三个动作：看整体、看结构、看比例
scenes.title_en: Three Moves: Whole Face, Structure, Proportions
scenes.context: 『有效设计』不是看局部把鼻子垫高，而是三步走：先看整体轮廓，再看骨相结构，最后用比例关系定方案。鼻子的最终美丑由它在全脸的位置决定。
sentences: 有效设计第一步：看整体，不是看局部。
Effective design step one: look at the whole face, not the feature.
feature（局部特征）
第二步看结构，骨相决定软组织走向。
Step two, look at structure — the bone dictates how the soft tissue sits.
soft tissue（软组织）
第三步，用比例关系决定方案。
Step three, let proportions decide the plan.
proportions（比例）
paraphrase: Zoom out before you zoom in on the nose.
Skin follows bone, so start with the frame.
scenes.speak: Effective design step one: look at the whole face, not the feature. Step two, look at structure — the bone dictates how the soft tissue sits. Step three, let proportions decide the plan.

scenes.title_cn: 鼻额角与三庭：上半张脸的密码
scenes.title_en: The Nasofrontal Angle and the Golden Thirds
scenes.context: 鼻额角决定侧脸的立体感：角度合适，眉眼深邃、面部有层次；角度过钝会显得平，过锐则显凶。三庭五眼中，鼻子的长度与中庭直接挂钩。
sentences: 鼻额角是侧脸立体感的关键。
The nasofrontal angle is the key to a sculpted profile.
nasofrontal angle（鼻额角）
角度过钝会显得面部扁平。
Too obtuse an angle flattens the whole face.
obtuse（钝的）
鼻子的长度，与中庭的比例直接挂钩。
Nose length is tied directly to the middle-third proportions.
middle third（中庭）
paraphrase: 「侧面好不好看看角度」换种说法
That one angle can make or break your profile.
「鼻长与脸等分挂钩」换种说法
The nose should live in balance with the face's thirds.
scenes.speak: The nasofrontal angle is the key to a sculpted profile. Too obtuse an angle flattens the whole face. Nose length is tied directly to the middle-third proportions.

scenes.title_cn: 正面四要素：鼻翼、鼻头、鼻孔、鼻骨宽度
scenes.title_en: Front Four: Ala, Tip, Nostrils, Bridge Width
scenes.context: 正面看鼻子的四个维度：鼻翼宽度与内眦对位、鼻头轮廓的圆润度、鼻孔的形状与对称、鼻骨宽窄决定精致度。四者协调才有辨识度。
sentences: 鼻翼宽度最好与内眼角对位。
The ala width should align with the inner corners of your eyes.
ala（鼻翼）
鼻头不是越小越好，要轮廓协调。
A smaller tip isn't always better — the contour must fit.
contour（轮廓）
鼻孔的形状与对称，最影响正面精致度。
Nostril shape and symmetry drive how refined the front view feels.
symmetry（对称）
paraphrase: Judge the nose from four angles, never just one.
「协调胜过绝对大小」换种说法
Fit beats absolute size every time.
scenes.speak: The ala width should align with the inner corners of your eyes. A smaller tip isn't always better — the contour must fit. Nostril shape and symmetry drive how refined the front view feels.

scenes.title_cn: 设计终局：审美是减法，辨识度来自协调
scenes.title_en: The Endgame: Aesthetics Is Subtraction, Distinction Comes from Harmony
scenes.context: 高级的脸不是把每个部位都做到极致，而是每个部位都不过分。真正的辨识度来自整体协调，而不是单一部位的夸张。
sentences: 高级的美是克制，不是堆砌。
Refined beauty is restraint, not accumulation.
restraint（克制）
每个部位都不过分，整体反而更有辨识度。
When no single feature overdoes it, the whole face stands out more.
stand out（突出）
方案的最后一步，是把它放回整张脸再验一遍。
The final step is putting the plan back on the whole face to check it again.
check it again（再验证）
paraphrase: Sometimes the best tweak is no tweak.
Step back and re-judge the face as one piece.
scenes.speak: Refined beauty is restraint, not accumulation. When no single feature overdoes it, the whole face stands out more. The final step is putting the plan back on the whole face to check it again.

practice: Effective design starts with the whole face.
「鼻额角太钝会显得平」怎么表达？
Too obtuse an angle flattens the profile.
「协调胜过绝对大小」用英文怎么说？
pitfalls: Zoom in on the nose and ignore the face.
Design from the whole face down to the nose.
A nose only looks good in its face-wide context.
Match the tip contour to the whole face.
An overdone tip reads as unnatural, not refined.
Stop at the plan without rechecking.
Verify the plan against the full face at the end.
A great feature can still fail the final full-face test.
